# Grades — AP Physics stand-in

Made-up titles with the scores of a real AP Physics 1 gradebook (2026-11-27) whose
teacher weights items without saying so (test/grades-page.html?physics). `{97.4537}`
after a score is the exact value Schoology puts in the score's title; `{%98.795180722892}`
on a category is its exact percent; `[gc]` marks a column typed straight into the
gradebook (.is-grade-column). Schoology showed 99.15% for the course.
